Because the goal of demand flexibility is to modify the load profile for a small number of days per year, metrics that evaluate the ability to modify the load are more useful than annualized energy consumption impacts. There are many ways that the peak load impact of demand flexibility can be quantified. For this analysis, we adopted the demand decrease percentage (D3) metric, as defined by (Jingjing Liu, 2022). It can also be computed for the whole building load or for individual end uses.
